parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime imposes tier-1 universal exposures: birth-sex passports/facilities, entry refusal and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility for document discrepancy, and birth-sex prison/immigration custody with documented hormone removal, forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse. State adds binary facilities law covering bathrooms, shelters, dorms and prisons, no statewide discrimination protection, and religious-refusal immunity. Litigation, hate-crime law, city ordinances and no execution reduce severity, but functioning courts are also enforcing hostile policy and have allowed passport restrictions. No documented arrest under the state facilities law or organised sweeps, so above 0.25.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary sex definition; X/mismatched passports no longer issued, Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025. Entry cable: discrepancy or doubt about sex requires refusal; suspected wilful misrepresentation may support permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility. Passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry. Fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers. ACLU suit and allied advisories ongoing; some orders enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch at entry can escalate from refusal to fraud investigation, detention and birth-sex custody; state ID rules do not cure federal entry decision.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: From 2026 national corrections bureau adopted conversion-therapy model: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric drugs; denial of care reported, prisoner counts stopped. Immigration custody: forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse reported for trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented operative remedy for visitor detention; prisoner data collection stopped. Hate-crime statute does not govern custody conditions.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any entry, trespass or immigration detention can lead to birth-sex placement and documented custodial abuse; state facilities law expressly includes prisons.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. State March 2025 law defines woman/man binary, covers bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters, dormitories, prisons. National map: many states have bans; 4 criminalise in some circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No statewide anti-discrimination protection in division; 15 cities have local protections, subject to possible nullification bill not sourced as passed. Some federal orders blocked/enjoined.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal ban applies in federal buildings, state ban in state buildings; visitor cannot avoid by choosing jurisdiction layer. Trespass example requires willful entry plus refusal to depart.

care_services.exposure: National orders target gender-affirming care for minors; 27 states ban minor care. Hormone removal in custody documented. State adult insurance exclusion overturned then reinstated on appeal 2026, challenge unresolved.
care_services.protection: Emergency care not documented as denied in dossier; adult coverage litigation pending. No documented visitor care-access protection.
care_services.interaction: Custody hormone removal and minor-care bans affect travelling families; adult visitor refill/continuity not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Official framing of gender ideology, counterterrorism strategy prioritising groups described as radically pro-transgender, funding freeze, sports and military bans. State governor framed facilities as private for women only. No documented sweeps or arrests under state facilities law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National employment discrimination prohibition (2020 ruling) and hate-crime statute covering gender identity; only 23 states cover it in bias statutes (2019).
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile framing raises police discretion at borders/facilities, while courts both enjoin some orders and allowed passport restrictions — enforcement, not just paper, is operative.

minors_guardians.exposure: National EO directs investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating minor social transition including names/pronouns; minor care banned in 27 states; state athletics ban by reproductive biology, Supreme Court hearing pending. Student-outing bill passed both houses, final disposition not documented.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented visitor-specific protection for minors/guardians; athletics ban held unconstitutional by appeals court in 2024, now under Supreme Court review.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor faces school, sports, care and outing risks distinct from adult; guardian could face investigation framing if facilitating transition.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented pattern of street violence against visitors, police extortion, or targeted killings in dossier. Public opinion 2025: 66% support birth-sex on ID documents. Religious-refusal statute permits service/housing/government denial with qualified immunity.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No documented specific refusal under religious-refusal statute. Hate-crime law nationally punishable; 22 states plus capital outlaw gender-identity discrimination.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Social attitudes plus immunity may reduce recourse for service denial, but no documented visitor assault pattern to extrapolate.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit unresolved, several executive orders blocked/enjoined, adult care and athletics cases pending. State placed in Worst group, one tier below Do Not Travel in Aug 2026 assessment. Final status of local-ordinance nullification and student-outing bills not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have enjoined some measures and legal-aid FAQ exists; remedies are slow and inconsistent, and Supreme Court allowed key passport restriction.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty itself is exposure: traveller cannot rely on enjoined vs operative status at travel date, especially at entry and in custody.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar tier-1 birth-sex prison housing with assault risk, slow remedies, no execution. This case adds entry permanent-ineligibility risk and documented immigration-custody sexual abuse/forced labour, but also stronger litigation and no documented facilities-law arrests, so modestly above 0.25.

0.35-B has routine police stops, hours detention, fines, deference to police, no imprisonment. This case exceeds it: possible lifetime entry bar, federal/state universal facilities exclusion, and severe documented custody abuse, placing it below 0.35.

0.55-C centres on ward placement by document marker causing delayed/denied non-urgent care, with advocate/ethics remedies and no detention pathway. This case has that plus entry refusal/fraud, prison conversion therapy and immigration abuse, so materially lower.

0.45-D has universal registration exposing visitors, harassment/eviction, uncommon imprisonment. Shared universal exposure, but this dossier documents custodial hormone removal and sexual abuse, pushing below 0.45.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is cumulative: document discrepancy at entry triggers refusal/fraud risk; any detention moves visitor into birth-sex facilities/custody where hormone removal and abuse are documented; state law extends birth-sex rules to shelters, dorms and prisons while religious-refusal immunity weakens service recourse. Protections—employment/hate-crime law, city ordinances, active litigation—operate but do not pre-empt federal entry, federal facilities, federal custody or state facilities enforcement, and courts have allowed the passport regime. Hence severe if-outed consequences despite no execution and no documented state-law arrest.
